systems.platform: records synchronise with the NRB Database
systems.owner: National Registration Bureau, with funds from the Government of Malawi
systems.tiers: Phase One in Chitipa, Likoma, Dedza, Blantyre Rural and Machinga, 26 January to 4 February 2026, about 2,000 registration staff including teachers; slightly over 970,400 records synchronised by 6 February 2026, about 88 per cent of the 1.1 million targeted; seven phases planned, about 8 million children targeted
central; receives the campaign's synchronised records
